title: Atlas Deprecation Ledger Index
purpose: Durable knowledge-side index for the Atlas migration lifecycle without duplicating the runtime deprecation entries.
current_phase: Atlas foundation implemented; compatibility surfaces retained while canonical Nodes, Artifacts and Views progressively replace legacy ownership assumptions.
ownership_rule: Deprecation entry state, replacement targets and removal preconditions are owned only by data/atlas-deprecations.json. This index owns discovery and governance links, not duplicate entry state.
removal_rule: No legacy surface is removed merely because an Atlas replacement exists. Removal requires replacement coverage, route compatibility or redirects, passing quality gates, and explicit satisfaction of the runtime ledger preconditions.
